title: Choose a value
summary: F#: Choose a value. Try score 3. Try a small example and check what happens.
introduction: if is an expression with then and else results. Read the example, then check the result.

blocks.text: Install the .NET SDK. Save each example as lesson.fsx and run dotnet fsi lesson.fsx.

blocks.title: Choose a value
blocks.code:
let score = 8
let message = if score >= 5 then "Pass" else "Try again"
printfn "%s" message

blocks.text: The true rule chooses Pass as the value stored in message.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: The two result branches must agree in type.
